changelog: Multi-device support: unique per-device hostname/hotspot SSID/QR codes (v0.13.0). Hotspot-mode ticker with 2-min auto-expiry. New 'Disconnect now' + idle-timeout to release a phone from the setup hotspot without tearing it down. Fixed WiFi toggle giving no feedback during a transition. Fixed reconnect falling back to hotspot with no recovery path if the remembered profile was stale - now matches by SSID and restores the hotspot explicitly on failure. journald persistence + avahi mDNS refresh fixes.
